_comment: Hosts found by check.mjs in runtime source. Each value says why the host cannot receive data under offline.patch.yml. A new host fails the check until it is reviewed and added here.

disabled.dsh-otel-collector.deepseeksvc.com: telemetry and product analytics rows disabled
disabled.trtgsjkv6r.feishu.cn: contact form link in ui-settings-account, row disabled
disabled.download.deepseek.com: desktop updater runs only from a packaged build with publishing config
disabled.huggingface.co: experimental speech-to-text model download, not mounted; also a selectable llm-pi-ai provider
disabled.hf-mirror.com: experimental speech-to-text model download, not mounted
disabled.registry.npmmirror.com: plugin-manager fallback registries emptied; plugin detail CDN only on explicit plugin browsing
disabled.cdn.jsdelivr.net: plugin detail CDN, only on explicit plugin browsing
disabled.unpkg.com: plugin detail CDN, only on explicit plugin browsing
disabled.raw.githubusercontent.com: plugin market details and site glyphs, only on explicit plugin browsing
disabled.github.com: plugin installs from GitHub specs and links, only on explicit user action
disabled.gist.github.com: plugin installs from gist specs, only on explicit user action
disabled.harness.deepseek.com: deepseek-account harnessOrigin is https://127.0.0.1:9 and ui-account-notifications is disabled (offline.patch.yml); the desktop mandatory-update policy origin is https://127.0.0.1:9 in the packaging env (desktop/env.windows.example)

userAction.codeload.github.com: upstream-skills downloads a pinned skills archive only when a CLI app plugin registers with it; none ships upstream, so only a plugin the user installs does (plugin installs go to loopback by default); that plugin's skillsDir avoids the download
userAction.mcp.linear.app: Linear MCP server of the dsh-linear connector bundle; no shipped profile or bundle lists it, so it mounts only when the user installs it (plugin installs go to loopback by default), and it connects only after the user signs in to Linear
userAction.mcp.notion.com: Notion MCP server of the dsh-notion connector bundle; no shipped profile or bundle lists it, so it mounts only when the user installs it (plugin installs go to loopback by default), and it connects only after the user signs in to Notion

modelRoute.api.deepseek.com: llm-deepseek baseURL pinned to DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL or loopback; legacy search row disabled; web tools follow the model route; deepseek-account inferenceOrigin is https://127.0.0.1:9

userSelectedProvider.ai-gateway.vercel.sh: llm-pi-ai provider catalog; used only when configured on the Models page

notRuntime.api.github.com: private release and site tools (apps/desktop-publisher, apps/plugin-market-generator); no profile loads them
notRuntime.api.npmjs.org: private site tool apps/plugin-market-generator; no profile loads it

notContacted.gitlab.com: example URL in a doc comment of experimental forge-gitlab, which is not mounted and asks only the host the user names, through glab
notContacted.preview.invalid: reserved .invalid base for a same-origin test
